newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Heartland Wireless cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Heartland Wireless cut.

text.p: -- Bankers Trust analysts Mark McFadden and Curt Crofford on Monday cut their rating for Heartland Wireless Communications Inc to market perform from buy.
-- "We urge investors to be cautious," they wrote in an analysis.

-- "Given the company's current difficulties and the lack of information about why it will post negative EBITDA (earnings before income tax, depreciation and amortization) ... we are leery of this stock even at its currently reduced price."
-- The Dallas cable television company's shares were down 1/4 to 3-5/8 in moderate trade.
